光の中でさえ、嵐は止まないな。\r\n: Even in the light, the storm is unceasing.
とどのつまり、繋ぐよ、て。\r\n: After all is said and done, hands will connect.
生きる術を探す前に至るそれ、形を見つけて。\r\n: Before setting out to search for a way to live, discover its shape.
風、風、風、風さ！\r\n: O wind, o wind, o wind, o wind, come!
